title: The Sold-Out Zelda Switch 2 Is Coming Back
summary:
Good news for Zelda fans who missed out: the sold-out Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 is coming back very soon. Nintendo announced the special set in September 2026 to mark 40 years of the Zelda franchise and the release of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake.

When preorders opened, the set sold out on every storefront in a matter of seconds. The only way to get one was through resellers on eBay, where fans had to pay much more than the retail price. Bill van Zyll, Nintendo's vice president and general manager for Latin America, said the company "underestimated how well it would be received" — but reassured fans that Nintendo was "working on replenishments."

Now keen-eyed fans have spotted a message on the Nintendo Store page saying that "more inventory is on the way on January 2027." The page still lists the set as sold out, but the message matches Nintendo's earlier promises that more consoles were coming.

The game itself is a smash hit. The Ocarina of Time remake came out on November 5, 2026, and sold more than 5 million copies in its first four days, making it the second-best-selling Switch 2 game. It quickly became one of the best-reviewed games in recent years, overshadowed only by the launch of GTA 6.

It does not hurt that the special hardware looks great, too. The controllers and the Switch 2 come in the black, gold and green colors of the hero, Link, along with the Triforce symbol and the Hylian Crest. Hopefully this time Nintendo will have enough to go around — and scalpers will not get another field day.
why_it_matters: For fans who missed out, a second chance to buy the set at the normal price matters — and the remake's huge sales show just how loved Zelda still is.
